Authentication is the foundation of everything we do. We've been in this space long enough to know exactly what to look for, and every single piece gets checked before it goes out. If we're ever unsure about something, we don't touch it. Our whole business runs on trust — we're not putting that at risk for anything.

We ship nationwide. You can order directly through our online store, or if you'd rather keep it personal, DM us on Instagram and we'll handle it from there. Everything ships fully insured with tracking. We're based in NYC, so local meetups in the area are always an option too.

Most orders ship within 1–2 business days after payment clears. Domestic delivery is typically 2–5 business days depending on your location and the carrier. We'll send you tracking as soon as it's on the way. Need it faster? Ask us upfront — we'll tell you honestly what's possible.

Same product, same quality, same guarantee — just two different ways to get there. The online store is great if you already know what you want. Instagram is better if you have questions first, need us to source something specific, or just prefer talking to a real person before buying. Both work.

For online orders, we accept major cards and secure checkout through our store. For Instagram or in-person deals, we typically use Zelle, Venmo, PayPal, or cash for local meetups — whatever we agree on before the transaction. We'll always confirm the total and method before you pay. No surprises.

Easy. DM us on Instagram or email support@bounitnyc.com with a photo, the size, and the condition. We'll get back to you with an offer the same day. If we're good, we set up a time to meet or you ship it to us. We pay immediately — no games, no delays.

We buy deadstock, lightly worn, and well-kept used — as long as they're authentic and honestly described. OG box and extra laces help on sneakers. Be upfront about flaws, yellowing, or missing pieces; it speeds up your quote and avoids surprises on meetup day.

Yes — we've done closet cleanouts and multi-pair deals many times. Send a spreadsheet or a folder of photos with sizes and conditions. We'll price the lot fairly based on current market, not lowball you piece by piece. Bigger deals may take a day or two to evaluate properly.

Yes, and this is one of the main things people come to us for. Tell us exactly what you're looking for — the colorway, size, condition — and we'll go find it. We have a solid network built over years in this space. Just be patient with rare pieces — they take time and cost what they cost.

DM us the style name, size, and condition you want (DS, VNDS, used, etc.). We'll check live market comps and come back with a real number — not a stale listing price. Quotes are usually same-day for common pairs; grails and samples may take a little longer.

The resell market moves constantly. A price that's accurate today might be off by next week. Rather than post numbers that go stale, we give you a real quote based on where the market is right now. It's always fair and always based on actual data.

For high-demand pieces we can do a short hold with a deposit — usually 24–48 hours depending on the item. Message us before assuming it's yours; if someone else pays first, it goes to them. We'll always be clear about hold terms upfront.

Because we're dealing with one-of-one inventory and market-priced goods, all sales are final once authenticated and delivered as described. If something arrives not as promised — wrong size, undisclosed flaw, authenticity concern — contact us immediately with photos and we'll make it right. That's on us.

We meet in safe, public spots around Manhattan and Brooklyn — think busy retail areas or agreed drop-off points, never random parking lots. We'll confirm time, place, and what to bring (ID if needed, exact cash amount, etc.) before you pull up. Safety and clarity for both sides.

Didn't find your answer? Email support@bounitnyc.com or DM @bounit.104 — we reply to every serious inquiry.
